text:
maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to sweep the action items into a concrete testing plan. Owners + timelines?

sami: I can take the KV eviction regression suite work. goal: add deterministic promptset + a load test case. target EOD Friday.

maya: Thanks. Can you link the ticket when you create it (INC-4521 style)? Also we should add a periodic chaos drill for node eviction, monthly cadence.

devon: I’ll own the chaos drill orchestration. Proposal: run a small chaos job in staging 1st week of every month, and a larger one each quarter.

leah: For regressions, we need two promptset buckets: "smoke" (fast) and "full" (slower). smoke runs in CI on every merge, full runs nightly.

juan: Agree. I can convert the postmortem sample prompts into the smoke bucket. Will open PR with prompt list.

maya: Nice. Who will wire the load test (500 RPS sustained for 5m) into our CI? Need a script and a dashboard.

sami: I’ll add a k6 job. rough k6 command: 
```
k6 run --vus 50 --duration 5m load-tests/kv-eviction.js
```
I’ll add a grafana panel for tail latency + 95th.

devon: For chaos, I’ll use the chaos-controller job, steps: 1) cordon a node, 2) kill runtime pod, 3) restore. Should be parameterized for CPU/memory.

maya: Great. Also: remediation ownership table — can we have a single spreadsheet or a ticket that maps owner -> action -> due? We should avoid email chains.

leah: I’ll create a GH issue template that lists: remediation, test added (yes/no), assigned owner, due date, verification steps. We can link it to the original postmortem.

juan: PRs: I’ll tag the promptset PR with `regression:kv-eviction` and assign to sam for load test review.

sami: Putting tentative dates: KV regression smoke in CI by Fri (2965518500), full nightly by next Wed (2966023300). Chaos first staging run 2026-04-01 (2966200000).

maya: Marking owners: sami (load + regression harness), juan (promptsets), devon (chaos), leah (GH issue template + owner table). I’ll put follow-up meeting on calendar for Thu 11am to confirm progress.

oncall-bot: Reminder set: follow-up meeting scheduled Thu 11:00. Agenda: owners report, PR links, dashboard readiness.

devon: One more item — automate converting incident logs into eval test cases. I can prototype a small script that pulls last-10 incidents and extracts request traces. Will open RFC next week.

maya: Love that. Make sure to include a checklist for SRs: add test, add dashboard, add runbook pointer.

leah: Copy that. I’ll post the GH issue and spreadsheet links in this thread when done.

maya: Perfect. Thanks everyone. If anything slips, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
